<title
    level="1"
    right="Item 5+"
    pfs=""
>
[Soulheart](/Equipment.aspx?ID=5194)
</title>

<spoilers>May contain spoilers from Bastion of Blasphemies</spoilers>

<traits>
<trait label="Rare" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=683" />
<trait label="Artifact" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=537" />
<trait label="Occult" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=662" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Pathfinder #224: Bastion of Blasphemies](/Sources.aspx?ID=357) pg. 236

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** held in 1 hand

**Bulk** L
</row>

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

A _soulheart_ is a crystallized sphere of red ectoplasm about the size of a human eye. When held by a living creature, a faint red light shimmers within the crystal, pulsating in a synchronized beat with the creature’s heartbeat and providing illumination equivalent to that of a candle. 

**Activate—Bolster Life** <actions string="Two Actions" /> ([concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=561), [manipulate](/Traits.aspx?ID=645)) **Frequency** once per day;   **Effect** When held to the chest and focused upon, the soul energy within the _soulheart_ floods outward and bolsters your life force, granting you temporary Hit Points. The number of temporary Hit Points granted depends on the type of the _soulheart_, but regardless of type, they last for 8 hours. 

**Activate—Bolster Maiserene Phantom** <actions string="Two Actions" /> ([concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=561), [manipulate](/Traits.aspx?ID=645))    **Effect** When touched to a Maiserene phantom of the proper rank (depending on the type of _soulheart_), the _soulheart_ flashes with bright red light and is destroyed. As it does so, it permanently increases the targeted phantom to rank 1, and increases each PC’s maximum Hit Points by 1 for as long as they remain within Bastardhall while the castle remains cursed. More powerful _soulhearts_ can increase higher-rank phantoms and grant more Hit Points.

**Destruction** A _soulheart_ is destroyed when it is activated to Bolster Maiserene Phantom, Restore Life, or Defy Charg.

<column gap="tiny">

</column>

<title
level="2"
right="Item 5"
pfs=""
>
Soulheart
</title>

<traits>

</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Pathfinder #224: Bastion of Blasphemies](/Sources.aspx?ID=357) pg. 236

<row gap="medium">

**Bulk** L

</row>

</column>

---

When used to Bolster Life, the _soulheart_ grants 6 temporary Hit Points (or 3 temporary Hit Points if it’s nighttime). Bolster Maiserene Phantom can only be activated on rank 0 phantoms. When bolstered, the phantom increases to rank 1, and all PCs gain 1 permanent Hit Point.

<title
level="2"
right="Item 10"
pfs=""
>
Soulheart (Greater)
</title>

<traits>

</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Pathfinder #224: Bastion of Blasphemies](/Sources.aspx?ID=357) pg. 236

<row gap="medium">

**Bulk** L

</row>

</column>

---

When used to Bolster Life, the _soulheart_ grants 12 temporary Hit Points (or 6 temporary Hit Points if it’s nighttime). Bolster Maiserene Phantom can only be activated on rank 1 phantoms. When bolstered, the phantom increases to rank 2, and all PCs gain 2 permanent Hit Points.

<title
level="2"
right="Item 15"
pfs=""
>
Soulheart (Major)
</title>

<traits>

</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Pathfinder #224: Bastion of Blasphemies](/Sources.aspx?ID=357) pg. 236

<row gap="medium">

**Bulk** L

</row>

</column>

---

When used to Bolster Life, the _soulheart_ grants 18 temporary Hit Points (or 9 temporary Hit Points if it’s nighttime). Bolster Maiserene Phantom can only be activated on rank 2 phantoms. When bolstered, the phantom increases to rank 3, and all PCs gain 3 permanent Hit Points.

<title
level="2"
right="Item 20"
pfs=""
>
Soulheart (Pure)
</title>

<traits>

</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Pathfinder #224: Bastion of Blasphemies](/Sources.aspx?ID=357) pg. 236

<row gap="medium">

**Bulk** L

</row>

</column>

---

A _pure soulheart_ doesn’t have a Bolster Life or Bolster Maiserene Phantom activation—instead, it has the following activation. 

**Activate—Restore Life** <actions string="" /> 1 minute ([concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=561), [manipulate](/Traits.aspx?ID=645))    **Effect** By holding a _pure soulheart_ against the remains of a dead creature of 20th level or lower that has been dead for no more than a year and concentrating for one minute, the _pure soulheart_ flashes with red light and is destroyed. The targeted dead creature is restored to life with 1 Hit Point, no spells prepared or spell slots available, no points in any pools or any other daily resources, and is still affected by any long-term debilitations of the old body.

<title
level="2"
right="Item 21"
pfs=""
>
Angelic Soulheart
</title>

<traits>

</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Pathfinder #224: Bastion of Blasphemies](/Sources.aspx?ID=357) pg. 236

<row gap="medium">

**Bulk** L

</row>

</column>

---

An _angelic soulheart_ doesn’t have a Bolster Life or Bolster Maiserene Phantom activation—instead, it has the following activation. 

**Activate—Defy Charg** <actions string="Single Action" /> ([concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=561), [manipulate](/Traits.aspx?ID=645))   **Requirements** Pharasma’s favor (earned by restoring the temple clock tower in Bastardhall), Shelyn’s favor (earned by restoring the gallery in Bastardhall’s reception halls), and Caydserris Arudora is defeated; **Effect** By presenting the _angelic soulheart_ to Charg at the climax of this Adventure Path, you can fully remove the Bastardhall Curse and free all of the souls trapped within! See page 222 for additional details.

A _soulheart_ is a crystallized sphere of red ectoplasm about the size of a human eye. When held by a living creature, a faint red light shimmers within the crystal, pulsating in a synchronized beat with the creature’s heartbeat and providing illumination equivalent to that of a candle. 

**Activate—Bolster Life** <actions string="Two Actions" /> ([concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=561), [manipulate](/Traits.aspx?ID=645)) **Frequency** once per day;   **Effect** When held to the chest and focused upon, the soul energy within the _soulheart_ floods outward and bolsters your life force, granting you temporary Hit Points. The number of temporary Hit Points granted depends on the type of the _soulheart_, but regardless of type, they last for 8 hours. 

**Activate—Bolster Maiserene Phantom** <actions string="Two Actions" /> ([concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=561), [manipulate](/Traits.aspx?ID=645))    **Effect** When touched to a Maiserene phantom of the proper rank (depending on the type of _soulheart_), the _soulheart_ flashes with bright red light and is destroyed. As it does so, it permanently increases the targeted phantom to rank 1, and increases each PC’s maximum Hit Points by 1 for as long as they remain within Bastardhall while the castle remains cursed. More powerful _soulhearts_ can increase higher-rank phantoms and grant more Hit Points.

**Destruction** A _soulheart_ is destroyed when it is activated to Bolster Maiserene Phantom, Restore Life, or Defy Charg.

>
[Soulspark Candle](/Equipment.aspx?ID=1816)
</title>

<spoilers>May contain spoilers from Blood Lords</spoilers>

<traits>
<trait label="Rare" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=137" />
<trait label="Artifact" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=253" />
<trait label="Consecration" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=34" />
<trait label="Divination" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=47" />
<trait label="Divine" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=48" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Pathfinder #186: Ghost King's Rage](/Sources.aspx?ID=189) pg. 79

<row gap="medium">

**Bulk** L
</row>

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

This thick, white pillar candle has flecks of ash and bone mixed amid the wax. When lit, the candle sheds [bright light](/Rules.aspx?ID=407) for 20 feet and [dim light](/Rules.aspx?ID=408) for a further 20 feet. The candle can't be snuffed by weather, water, or accident but can be purposefully snuffed through ritual prayer. The candle doesn't release heat and can't be used to start a fire. The candle is never exhausted, regardless of how long it burns.

 The area within the candle's light is a consecrated space. Worshippers of [Pharasma](/Deities.aspx?ID=14) within this area gain a +3 status bonus to attack rolls, skill checks, saving throws, and Perception checks. [Undead](/Traits.aspx?ID=160) creatures and worshippers of [Urgathoa](/Deities.aspx?ID=19) within this area take a –3 status penalty to those checks.

 When an undead creature or a [haunt](/Traits.aspx?ID=88) comes within the light of a _soulspark candle_, the candle's flame turns from red to black, makes a loud crackling sound, and releases a flash of bright sparks. The candle continues to burn black and crackle for as long as a haunt or undead remains in the area.

**Activate** <actions string="Single Action" /> Interact;     **Effect** You light the candle.

**Activate** <actions string="Single Action" /> command;    **Requirements** The candle is lit; **Effect** You put out the candle with ritual prayers to Pharasma.

**Activate** <actions string="Two Actions" /> command ([evocation](/Traits.aspx?ID=65), [light](/Traits.aspx?ID=100))   **Requirements** The candle is lit, and an undead is within the light's area; **Effect** You command the candle to illuminate the dead. All undead creatures in the area are limned in blue, heatless fire for as long as they remain in the area, plus 1 minute after they leave the area or the light goes out. Visible undead can't be [concealed](/Conditions.aspx?ID=4) while limned in these flames. [Invisible](/Conditions.aspx?ID=26) undead are concealed while limned in these flames, rather than being [undetected](/Conditions.aspx?ID=39). Haunts are unaffected by this light.

**Activate** <actions string="Three Actions" /> command ([divine](/Traits.aspx?ID=48), [evocation](/Traits.aspx?ID=65), [fire](/Traits.aspx?ID=72))   **Requirements** The candle is lit, and an undead or haunt is within the light's area; **Effect** You command the candle to destroy the undead. The candle's flame erupts into a mass of fire that burns away undead and haunts. Any undead within the candle's light takes 20d8 fire damage (DC 45 [basic](/Rules.aspx?ID=329) Fortitude save). Pharasma empowers these flames, allowing them to ignore fire resistance or immunity. Any haunts in the area are instead subject to Pharasma's banishing light. The candle attempts a check to disable each haunt with a +35 modifier. This check applies to any skills applicable to disable the haunt and always has legendary proficiency. Once the candle is Activated in this way, its light immediately goes out, and the candle can't be relit for 1 hour.

**Destruction** If a _soulspark candle_ is lit by an undead of at least 20th level that worships Urgathoa, the candle burns down as if it were a normal candle over the course of 48 hours. At the end of this time, if the candle is still burning, it burns away completely and is destroyed.

---

This grotesque, amulet-like shrunken head is said to hold a shard of its owner's psyche. The head is often that of a [humanoid](/Traits.aspx?ID=91), but any creature capable of speaking in life can provide the grisly component needed for this magic item's creation. The head can contain a short message whispered to it and can then be commanded to repeat the message later. While a _soulspeaker_ carries a message, the eyes of the shrunken head open, and they close as soon as its message is delivered.

**Activate** <actions string="Two Actions" /> command;     **Effect** You cast [_message_](/Spells.aspx?ID=190), but instead of your message being transferred directly to a target's ears, the message is stored in the _soulspeaker_. The _soulspeaker's_ eyes open, and the next time it's activated, the _soulspeaker_ repeats the message you spoke to it with a rasping whisper before its eyes close again, the message expended.

</title>

<traits>

</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

<row gap="medium">

</row>

<row gap="medium">
<row gap="tiny"><row>**Activate**</row><row>1 minute (Interact)</row></row>

---

This peculiar amber glue bonds two surfaces together almost inseparably. A single flask covers an area up to 1 square foot and must be used all at once to form a single bond between two surfaces. If the activation is interrupted, the bond fails and the glue is wasted.

 Once two surfaces are joined with sovereign glue, they can be separated only with a successful DC 50 [Athletics](/Skills.aspx?ID=3) check. The adhered objects tend to break before the glue does unless they're particularly durable, though a creature determined to separate the objects can break off the parts connected by the sovereign glue and later [Repair](/Actions.aspx?ID=42) the objects.

 Sovereign glue can affect creatures only if they are willing, and its bond can be harmlessly broken by carefully exfoliating the outermost layer of skin or waiting a short while for the skin to shed.

**Source** [Legends](/Sources.aspx?ID=40) pg. 77 --- Created by Black Sovereign Kevoth-Kul, this unique alloy of [cold iron](/Equipment.aspx?ID=272) and the skymetal [noqual](/Equipment.aspx?ID=1419) can provide protection from magical assault. The process of cold-forging the two materials together is quite complicated and precise. Characters in search of sovereign steel weapons and armor will almost assuredly have to travel to Starfall to procure gear made from this rare alloy. While some believe it possible to craft shields of sovereign steel as well, in one of his fits, Kevoth-Kul yelled that he had no use for them and banned anyone from making such a thing. So far, his smiths have been too afraid to confirm whether or not it was a joke. All sovereign steel items (including weapon and armor below) have a +4 circumstance bonus on saves against magic that the item makes, and grant their bonus to saves the owner makes specifically to protect the item from magic (such as against the [_rusting grasp_](/Spells.aspx?ID=711) spell). ## Soverign Steel Items

fields.text: Item 9+ Sovereign Steel Rare Precious Source Legends pg. 77 Created by Black Sovereign Kevoth-Kul, this unique alloy of cold iron and the skymetal noqual can provide protection from magical assault. The process of cold-forging the two materials together is quite complicated and precise. Characters in search of sovereign steel weapons and armor will almost assuredly have to travel to Starfall to procure gear made from this rare alloy. While some believe it possible to craft shields of sovereign steel as well, in one of his fits, Kevoth-Kul yelled that he had no use for them and banned anyone from making such a thing. So far, his smiths have been too afraid to confirm whether or not it was a joke. All sovereign steel items (including weapon and armor below) have a +4 circumstance bonus on saves against magic that the item makes, and grant their bonus to saves the owner makes specifically to protect the item from magic (such as against the rusting grasp spell). ## Soverign Steel Items Soverign Steel Items Hardness HP BT Thin Items Standard-grade 7 28 14 High-grade 10 40 20 Items Standard-grade 11 44 22 High-grade 14 56 28 Structures Standard-grade 22 88 44 High-grade 28 112 56 Material Uses Sovereign Steel Armor Sovereign Steel Weapon Item 9 Sovereign Steel Chunk Source Legends pg. 77 Price 700 gp Bulk L Item 9 Sovereign Steel Ingot Source Legends pg. 77 Price 7,000 gp Bulk L Item 9 Sovereign Steel Object (Standard-Grade) Source Legends pg. 77 Price 500 gp (per Bulk) Item 17 Sovereign Steel Object (High-Grade) Source Legends pg. 77 Price 8,000 gp (per Bulk)

**Source** [GM Core](/Sources.aspx?ID=218) pg. 276 **Usage** held in 2 hand **Bulk** 1 --- Though it appears to be a cloth bag decorated with panels of richly colored silk or stylish embroidery, a spacious pouch opens into a magical space larger than its outside dimensions. The Bulk held inside the bag doesn't change the Bulk of the _spacious pouch_ itself. The amount of Bulk the bag's extradimensional space can hold depends on its type.
You can Interact with the _spacious pouch_ to stow items in it or remove them just like a mundane sack. Though the bag can hold a great amount of material, an object still needs to be able to fit through the opening of the sack to be stored inside.
If the bag is overloaded or broken, it ruptures and is ruined, causing the items inside to be lost forever. If it's turned inside out, the items inside spill out unharmed, but the bag must be put right before it can be used again. A living creature placed inside the bag has enough air for 10 minutes before it begins to suffocate, and it can attempt to Escape against a DC of 13. An item inside the bag provides no benefits unless it's retrieved first. An item in the bag can't be detected by magic that detects only things on the same plane. fields.text: Item 4+ Spacious Pouch Extradimensional Magical Source GM Core pg. 276 Usage held in 2 hand Bulk 1 Though it appears to be a cloth bag decorated with panels of richly colored silk or stylish embroidery, a spacious pouch opens into a magical space larger than its outside dimensions. The Bulk held inside the bag doesn't change the Bulk of the spacious pouch itself. The amount of Bulk the bag's extradimensional space can hold depends on its type. You can Interact with the spacious pouch to stow items in it or remove them just like a mundane sack. Though the bag can hold a great amount of material, an object still needs to be able to fit through the opening of the sack to be stored inside. If the bag is overloaded or broken, it ruptures and is ruined, causing the items inside to be lost forever. If it's turned inside out, the items inside spill out unharmed, but the bag must be put right before it can be used again. A living creature placed inside the bag has enough air for 10 minutes before it begins to suffocate, and it can attempt to Escape against a DC of 13. An item inside the bag provides no benefits unless it's retrieved first. An item in the bag can't be detected by magic that detects only things on the same plane. <row gap="medium">
<row gap="tiny"><row>**Activate**</row><actions string="Single Action" /><row>([manipulate](/Traits.aspx?ID=104))</row></row>

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

These wafers contain ground-up alchemical reagents that activate shortly after being snapped. First popularized by technicians in Absalom’s Ivy Playhouse, they have spread throughout Golarion as an inexpensive way to add to the visual splendor of a show without relying on magic. When you activate a spark wafer, you bend the wafer, nearly snapping it in two, and then throw it at a corner of a square within 20 feet (all part of the same manipulate action). The wafer then releases a 10-foot-high column of sparks for 1 round. The sparks shed [bright light](/Rules.aspx?ID=2401) in a 5-foot burst and dim light in the next 5 feet. Any creature that begins their turn in the burst takes 1d4 fire damage (DC 14 basic Reflex save).

---

Vendors sell these strings of roasted peppers on festival nights in Dhuraxilis. Their spiciness cuts through the fatty meats that are also popular during late nights, and the sparks from the peppers serve as a pick-me-up to maintain the energy for a party. After you eat a sparking pepper string, your body bristles with [electricity](/Traits.aspx?ID=586) until the end of your next turn. When you successfully [Strike](/Actions.aspx?ID=2306) a target with an unarmed attack or a metal weapon, you can end this effect as a free action to have the attack deal an additional 1d6 electricity damage. If not expended before the duration ends, the electricity dissipates harmlessly.

**Source** [Treasure Vault (Remastered)](/Sources.aspx?ID=191) pg. 98 **Usage** held in 1 hand **Bulk** L **Activate**Strike --- A broad wooden tube with a handle, a _sparking spellgun_ radiates warmth. You Activate the spellgun by aiming it at one creature and making your choice of a spell attack roll or a firearm attack roll against the target's AC. This spellgun has a [range increment](/Traits.aspx?ID=248) of 30 feet. The spellgun fires a small ball of sparks and fire, then crumbles to ash. The ball explodes in a flash when it hits, dealing fire damage and [persistent fire damage](/Conditions.aspx?ID=29) according to its type. **Critical Success** The target takes double damage, takes double persistent damage, is [blinded](/Conditions.aspx?ID=1) for 1 round, and is [dazzled](/Conditions.aspx?ID=7) while the persistent damage lasts.
**Success** The target takes full damage, full persistent damage, and is dazzled while the persistent damage lasts. Sparking Spellgun (Lesser) **Source** [Treasure Vault (Remastered)](/Sources.aspx?ID=191) pg. 98 **Price** 30 gp **Bulk** L --- The damage is 4d6, and the persistent damage is 1d4. Sparking Spellgun (Moderate) **Source** [Treasure Vault (Remastered)](/Sources.aspx?ID=191) pg. 98 **Price** 150 gp **Bulk** L --- The damage is 7d6, and the persistent damage is 3d4. Sparking Spellgun (Greater) **Source** [Treasure Vault (Remastered)](/Sources.aspx?ID=191) pg. 98 **Price** 600 gp **Bulk** L --- The damage is 10d6, and the persistent damage is 5d4.

A sparkler gives off colorful sparks, burning for 1 minute. It provides [bright light](/Rules.aspx?ID=407) in a 10-foot radius (and [dim light](/Rules.aspx?ID=408) for the next 10 feet). While the sparkler burns, you can use it as an [improvised weapon](/Rules.aspx?ID=224), dealing 1 fire damage on a hit. On a critical hit, you cause the target to become [dazzled](/Conditions.aspx?ID=7) for 1 round.

 You can touch a sparkler to a flammable object as part of the same Interact action you use to Activate it or as an Interact action while the sparkler is already activated. If you do so, the sparkler can ignite flammable objects the way a [matchstick](/Equipment.aspx?ID=3356) does.

**Source** [Treasure Vault](/Sources.aspx?ID=320) pg. 98 **Usage** held in 1 hand **Bulk** L **Activate**Interact, Strike --- A broad wooden tube with a handle, a _sparking spellgun_ radiates warmth. You Activate the spellgun by aiming it at one creature and making your choice of a spell attack roll or a firearm attack roll against the target’s AC. This spellgun has a range increment of 30 feet. The spellgun fires a small ball of sparks and fire, then crumbles to ash. The ball explodes in a flash when it hits, dealing fire damage and [persistent fire damage](/Conditions.aspx?ID=86) according to its type. **Critical Success** The target takes double damage, takes double persistent damage, is [blinded](/Conditions.aspx?ID=59) for 1 round, and is [dazzled](/Conditions.aspx?ID=65) while the persistent damage lasts.
**Success** The target takes full damage, full persistent damage, and is dazzled while the persistent damage lasts. Sparkling Spellgun (Lesser) **Source** [Treasure Vault](/Sources.aspx?ID=320) pg. 98 **Price** 30 gp --- The damage is 4d6, and the persistent damage is 1d4. Sparkling Spellgun (Moderate) **Source** [Treasure Vault](/Sources.aspx?ID=320) pg. 98 **Price** 150 gp --- The damage is 7d6, and the persistent damage is 3d4. Sparkling Spellgun (Greater) **Source** [Treasure Vault](/Sources.aspx?ID=320) pg. 98 **Price** 600 gp --- The damage is 10d6, and the persistent damage is 5d4.

    pfs="Standard"
>
[Sparkshade Parasol](/Equipment.aspx?ID=2610)
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Fire" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=72" />
<trait label="Invested" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=98" />
<trait label="Magical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=103" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Rage of Elements](/Sources.aspx?ID=205) pg. 124

**Price** 1,200 gp

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** held in 1 hand

**Bulk** 1
</row>

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

This large magical parasol shields you from the heat in hot environments, no matter whether the heat comes from above, like the beating sun, or below, like roiling lava. While holding the _sparkshade parasol_, you gain resistance 10 to fire and are protected from [mild, severe, and extreme environmental heat](/Rules.aspx?ID=642).

**Activate—Parasol's Protection** <actions string="Reaction" /> ([manipulate](/Traits.aspx?ID=104)) **Frequency** once per 10 minutes; **Trigger** You're targeted by or inside the area of an effect that deals fire damage;  **Effect** You hold your parasol between yourself and the incoming flames, gaining fire resistance 20 against the triggering effect. (This applies only to any damage the effect deals.) For the next 1 minute, flames dance harmlessly along the parasol's brim, letting you use Parasol's Pyrotechnics.

**Activate—Parasol's Pyrotechnics** <actions string="Two Actions" /> ([concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=32), [manipulate](/Traits.aspx?ID=104))   **Requirements** Flames are dancing on the sparkshade parasol due to you using Parasol's Protection; **Effect** You release captured flames out from your parasol, shooting fire in a 30-foot line. Each creature in the line takes 10d6 fire damage (DC 28 [basic](/Rules.aspx?ID=329) Reflex save). This activation loses its charge.

<column gap="tiny">

</column>

<title
    level="1"
    right="Item 20"
    pfs="Standard"
>
[Spear of the Destroyer's Flame](/Equipment.aspx?ID=1472)
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Unique" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=161" />
<trait label="Artifact" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=253" />
<trait label="Evocation" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=65" />
<trait label="Magical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=103" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Monsters of Myth](/Sources.aspx?ID=107) pg. 16

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** held in 2 hands

**Bulk** 3
</row>

<row gap="medium">
**Base Weapon** [Longspear](/Weapons.aspx?ID=6)
</row>

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

The tip of this _+3 [major striking](/Equipment.aspx?ID=280) [greater flaming](/Equipment.aspx?ID=295) [returning](/Equipment.aspx?ID=301) [speed](/Equipment.aspx?ID=304) [longspear](/Weapons.aspx?ID=6)_ is edged with several razor-sharp obsidian blades. The spear has the [thrown 30 feet](/Traits.aspx?ID=195) weapon trait, in addition to the normal weapon traits for a longspear.

 While the _Spear of the Destroyer's Flame_ is in your possession, you gain [fire](/Traits.aspx?ID=72) resistance 20. When you critically hit a creature with the spear, the creature's blood begins to boil, unleashing blasts of heat from the wound. The creature takes 2d8 [persistent fire damage](/Conditions.aspx?ID=29), in addition to the persistent fire damage from the _greater flaming_ rune; all creatures adjacent to the creature when it takes the persistent fire damage take an equal amount of fire damage. Like the fire damage from the greater flaming rune, this fire damage ignores a creature's fire resistance, though it doesn't ignore fire immunity.

 In addition to its deadliness as a weapon, the _Spear of the Destroyer's Flame_ gives its wielder full control over the Army of Fire, though the orders of the Commander of Flame supersede the orders of anyone wielding the spear, as noted below. While the spear is in your possession, you're aware of the location of the Army of Fire and the army's distance from you. In addition, you can give orders to the Army of Fire, and the army's members will understand and obey you, regardless of what language you speak. If you're within 1 mile of the Army of Fire, the army and its members gain a +10 circumstance bonus to their Speeds. Any members of the Army of Fire within 100 feet of you become [quickened](/Conditions.aspx?ID=32) and can use the additional action to Step, Stride, or Strike. The army remains quickened for 1 minute after moving further than 100 feet from you.

 The Army of Fire has unwavering loyalty to the Commander of Flame, an individual who has completed a special activation that ties their soul to the spear. As long as the Army of Fire can see and hear the Commander of Flame, the army will follow the Commander's orders. The Commander of Flame can sense the presence of the Army of Fire and issue orders, regardless of language, with the same effects as for someone in possession of the spear. The Commander of Flame still needs the spear in hand to muster the Army of Fire, however.

 If the Commander of Flame doesn't hold the _Spear of the Destroyer's Flame_ for 1 week, it returns to [Cuetzmonquali's](/Monsters.aspx?ID=1722) gut, instantly teleporting to the creature's location. If Cuetzmonquali is dead at this time, the spear also resurrects the creature, using the effects of a critical success on a 10th-level [_resurrect_](/Rituals.aspx?ID=20) ritual.

**Activate** <actions string="" /> 1 minute (envision, Interact);  **Frequency** once per day;   **Effect** You attempt to tie your soul to the spear. If the current Commander of Flame still lives, you must attempt either a Will save, [Diplomacy](/Skills.aspx?ID=6) check, [Intimidation](/Skills.aspx?ID=7) check, or [Warfare Lore](/Skills.aspx?ID=8) check. The DC of this check is equal to the current Commander's Will DC, Diplomacy DC, Intimidation DC, or Warfare Lore DC, whichever is highest. On a success, you become the Commander of Flame. On a failure, the current Commander knows your name and appearance and is aware of your exact location for 24 hours.

**Activate** <actions string="" /> 1 hour (envision, Interact);  **Frequency** once per week;   **Effect** You use the spear's power to muster the Army of Fire. You can choose to either call the Army of Fire to your location or move yourself to the army's location. When calling the army, you select an area you can see within 500 feet. The army is instantly teleported to the location you select, spreading out as necessary to arrive safely. When moving yourself, you instantly teleport yourself to a location within 500 feet of the army. The army is composed of souls given form as burning humanoids, elementals, spirits, and undead.

**Destruction** If the entire Army of Fire is destroyed and the Commander of Flame is slain with the _Spear of the Destroyer's Flame_, the spear shatters into a massive explosion of flame, dealing 20d10 fire damage in a 30-foot burst (DC 43 [basic](/Rules.aspx?ID=329) Reflex save). In addition, the Commander's soul burns away to nothing, destroying the Commander forever and releasing the bound souls of the Army of Fire to the River of Souls.

</column>

---

Each _specialist's ring_ is dedicated to a single school of magic, and the ring is covered in symbols and glyphs related to that school according to the creator's arcane studies. A _specialist's ring_ has the trait corresponding to its school of magic. You gain a +2 item bonus to [Arcana](/Skills.aspx?ID=2) checks, and a +1 circumstance bonus to recognize magical effects and items of the specific school of magic.

**Activate** <actions string="Free Action" /> envision;  **Frequency** once per day;   **Effect** You gain 1 Focus Point, which you can use only to cast a wizard school spell of the corresponding school. If not used by the end of your turn, this Focus Point is lost.

>
[Spectacles of Discernment](/Equipment.aspx?ID=3631)
</title>

<spoilers>May contain spoilers from Curtain Call</spoilers>

<traits>
<trait label="Unique" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=161" />
<trait label="Magical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=103" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Pathfinder #204: Stage Fright](/Sources.aspx?ID=245) pg. 80

**Price** 3,000 gp

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** held in 1 hand

**Bulk** L
</row>

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

Designed for a frequent sponsor of theatrical productions who liked to stay informed of all the off-stage drama, these silver opera glasses are affixed to a slender redwood handle. They can’t be worn on the face but must be raised to the eyes and held there, at which point the spectacles of discernment grant a +2 item bonus to [Perception](/Rules.aspx?ID=2298) checks to notice details at a distance.

**Activate—Reveal the Truth** <actions string="Single Action" /> ([manipulate](/Traits.aspx?ID=645)) **Frequency** once per day;   **Effect** You raise the spectacles to regard a target creature through them; the target must be within 60 feet. You immediately gain the ability to speak and understand the language the target creature is currently speaking, or its native language if it’s not currently talking, for 24 hours. During this time, you can Interact with the spectacles of discernment to flip down a pair of supplementary lenses. When you do so, if you’re observing the creature you originally targeted, roll a secret [counteract](/Rules.aspx?ID=3280) check with a counteract modifier of +23 against any [illusion](/Traits.aspx?ID=629), [morph](/Traits.aspx?ID=657), or [polymorph](/Traits.aspx?ID=670) effect affecting the target, but only for the purpose of determining whether you see through the disguise or not.

</column>

    right="Item 12"

[Spectacles of Inquiry](/Equipment.aspx?ID=2316)
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Invested" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=98" />
<trait label="Magical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=103" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Treasure Vault (Remastered)](/Sources.aspx?ID=191) pg. 147

**Price** 1,750 gp

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** worn eyepiece

</row>

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

---

Anything viewed through these thin spectacles looks crisp and clear, and the earpieces accentuate sounds around you. You gain a +2 item bonus to Perception checks.

**Activate** <actions string="Single Action" /> ([concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=561)) **Frequency** once per hour;   **Effect** The spectacles key in on someone to show you their social cues in perfect clarity. Choose a creature you can see. You gain a +3 item bonus on Perception checks you make to use [Sense Motive](/Actions.aspx?ID=85) against that creature. This benefit lasts until you Activate the item again in this way.

 If you’re an [investigator](/Classes.aspx?ID=59), you can use this activation as part of the [Devise a Stratagem](/Actions.aspx?ID=2813) action (even if you’re doing it as a free action). Alternatively, you can use it as part of the [Pursue a Lead](/Actions.aspx?ID=2811) activity, even though you can’t see the creature. You must choose the same creature you chose for Devise a Stratagem or Pursue a Lead.

**Craft Requirements** You are an investigator.

fields.text: Item 12 Spectacles of Inquiry Invested Magical Source Treasure Vault (Remastered) pg. 147 Price 1,750 gp Usage worn eyepiece Anything viewed through these thin spectacles looks crisp and clear, and the earpieces accentuate sounds around you. You gain a +2 item bonus to Perception checks. Activate Single Action (concentrate) Frequency once per hour; Effect The spectacles key in on someone to show you their social cues in perfect clarity. Choose a creature you can see. You gain a +3 item bonus on Perception checks you make to use Sense Motive against that creature. This benefit lasts until you Activate the item again in this way. If you’re an investigator, you can use this activation as part of the Devise a Stratagem action (even if you’re doing it as a free action). Alternatively, you can use it as part of the Pursue a Lead activity, even though you can’t see the creature. You must choose the same creature you chose for Devise a Stratagem or Pursue a Lead. Craft Requirements You are an investigator.

</title>

**Price** 1,750 gp

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** worn eyepiece

</row>

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

---

Anything viewed through these thin spectacles looks crisp and clear, and the earpieces accentuate sounds around you. You gain a +2 item bonus to [Perception](/Rules.aspx?ID=2040) checks.

**Activate** <actions string="Single Action" /> envision;  **Frequency** once per hour;   **Effect** The spectacles key in on someone to show you their social cues in perfect clarity. Choose a creature you can see. You gain a +3 item bonus on [Perception](/Rules.aspx?ID=2040) checks you make to use [Sense Motive](/Actions.aspx?ID=2302) against that creature. This benefit lasts until you Activate the item again in this way. 

If you’re an [investigator](/Classes.aspx?ID=59), you can use this activation as part of the action you take to [Devise a Stratagem](/Actions.aspx?ID=2813) or [Pursue a Lead](/Actions.aspx?ID=2811), and you can do the latter even though you can’t see the creature. You must choose the same creature you chose for Devise a Stratagem or Pursue a Lead.

**Craft Requirements** You are an [investigator](/Classes.aspx?ID=59).

</column>

**Usage** worn eyepiece

</row>

<row gap="medium">

---

With lenses set in a silver frame, _spectacles of piercing_ sight grant you a +3 item bonus to visual Perception checks.

**Activate** <actions string="Single Action" /> ([concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=561)) **Frequency** once per hour;   **Effect** You can see into and through solid matter for 1 minute. This vision can pierce through solid materials up to 20 feet away as if looking at something in normal light even if no illumination is available. You can see through up to 1 foot of stone, 1 inch of metal, or 3 feet of wood or dirt. A thin sheet of lead blocks this vision entirely.

</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Uncommon" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=159" />
<trait label="Divination" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=47" />
<trait label="Invested" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=98" />

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [PFS Guide](/Sources.aspx?ID=50) pg. 117

_[**PFS Note**](/pathfinder-society) All characters have access to this item_

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** worn

</row>

**Access** Member of the Pathfinder Society.

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

These folding, wood-framed spectacles hold flat discs of cut crystal as lenses and are held in place with thin cords that wrap around each ear, with another strap holding them around the neck while not in use. While you are wearing the spectacles, you gain a +1 item bonus to checks to [Decipher Writing](/Actions.aspx?ID=22).

**Activate** <actions string="Single Action" /> Interact;  **Frequency** once per day;   **Effect** Unfolding the spectacles onto the bridge of the nose, you gain the effects of 2nd-level [_comprehend language_](/Spells.aspx?ID=46) for one hour except that it applies to all languages you see rather than a single language, and it does not apply to language you hear.

</title>

<spoilers>May contain spoilers from Agents of Edgewatch</spoilers>

<traits>
<trait label="Uncommon" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=159" />

</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Pathfinder #160: Assault on Hunting Lodge Seven](/Sources.aspx?ID=49) pg. 66

**Price** 450 gp

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** held in 1 hand

**Bulk** L
</row>

<row gap="medium">
<row gap="tiny"><row>**Activate**</row><actions string="Single Action" /><row>Interact</row></row>

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

Belladonna cultivated in planes hazardous to living visitors, such as the [Shadow Plane](/Planes.aspx?ID=11) or the [Boneyard](/Planes.aspx?ID=15), grow with a strange, skeletal look to their branches. The leaves and berries of these extraplanar plants are partly incorporeal and significantly more toxic than [belladonna](/Equipment.aspx?ID=105) grown on the [Material Plane](/Planes.aspx?ID=1). When imbued with spirit-twisting magic, _spectral nightshade_ quickly drains away the victim's vitality and makes colors painfully bright and bewildering. _Spectral nightshade_ doesn't affect creatures that have no spirit; if a possessing spirit inhabits a body that takes poison damage from spectral nightshade, the possessor takes an equal amount of force damage, even if the possessor can't be affected directly by poisons.

 **Saving Throw** DC 33 Fortitude; **Onset** 1 minute; **Maximum Duration** 6 minutes; **Stage 1** 10d6 poison damage and [dazzled](/Conditions.aspx?ID=7) (1 minute); **Stage 2** 13d6 poison damage and [drained 1](/Conditions.aspx?ID=10) (1 minute); **Stage 3** 15d6 poison damage, [confused](/Conditions.aspx?ID=5), and drained 2 (1 minute)

**Craft Requirements** Supply one casting of [_spirit blast_](/Spells.aspx?ID=301).

<column gap="tiny">

</column>

fields.text: Item 13 Spectral Nightshade May contain spoilers from Agents of Edgewatch Uncommon Consumable Divine Ingested Poison Source Pathfinder #160: Assault on Hunting Lodge Seven pg. 66 Price 450 gp Usage held in 1 hand Bulk L Activate Single Action Interact Belladonna cultivated in planes hazardous to living visitors, such as the Shadow Plane or the Boneyard, grow with a strange, skeletal look to their branches. The leaves and berries of these extraplanar plants are partly incorporeal and significantly more toxic than belladonna grown on the Material Plane. When imbued with spirit-twisting magic, spectral nightshade quickly drains away the victim's vitality and makes colors painfully bright and bewildering. Spectral nightshade doesn't affect creatures that have no spirit; if a possessing spirit inhabits a body that takes poison damage from spectral nightshade, the possessor takes an equal amount of force damage, even if the possessor can't be affected directly by poisons. Saving Throw DC 33 Fortitude; Onset 1 minute; Maximum Duration 6 minutes; Stage 1 10d6 poison damage and dazzled (1 minute); Stage 2 13d6 poison damage and drained 1 (1 minute); Stage 3 15d6 poison damage, confused, and drained 2 (1 minute) Craft Requirements Supply one casting of spirit blast .

</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Grimoire" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=387" />
<trait label="Magical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=103" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Treasure Vault (Remastered)](/Sources.aspx?ID=191) pg. 113

**Price** 1,750 gp

<row gap="medium">

**Bulk** L
</row>

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

Metal clasps line the spine of this book, and diagrams displaying proper somatic casting forms are etched into its cover.

**Activate** <actions string="Reaction" /> ([concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=561)) **Frequency** once per day; **Trigger** You're targeted with an [arcane](/Traits.aspx?ID=11) spell attack and you have this grimoire raised; **Requirements** You have the [Raise a Tome](/Feats.aspx?ID=2848) feat; **Effect** The grimoire attempts to absorb knowledge of the spell targeting you. You attempt to [counteract](/Rules.aspx?ID=2250) the triggering spell. If you succeed, the spell is absorbed into the grimoire, and the diagrams on the cover change to indicate the somatic gestures and sigils for the counteracted spell. While the grimoire contains a spell, you can spend a spell slot of the same or higher rank as the spell in the grimoire to cast that spell instead, heightened to the appropriate rank (if you spent a higher-rank spell slot). After you cast the spell, it’s expended from the grimoire.

</column>

>
[Spell Echo Shot](/Equipment.aspx?ID=2058)
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Consumable" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=36" />
<trait label="Magical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=103" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Treasure Vault (Remastered)](/Sources.aspx?ID=191) pg. 83

**Price** 5,500 gp

<row gap="medium">
**Ammunition** any

</row>

<row gap="medium">
<row gap="tiny"><row>**Activate**</row><actions string="Single Action" /><row>([concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=561))</row></row>

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

Generous amounts of [djezet](/Equipment.aspx?ID=1410) and [orichalcum](/Equipment.aspx?ID=2919) mix in a _spell echo shot_. When you Activate it, you name up to four creatures, in addition to you, that the ammunition's magic works for. When _spell echo shot_ strikes a target, which can be a square, it remains intact. It moves with a creature it struck, unless the GM determines otherwise, until that creature regains any Hit Points. If it doesn't stick to the target, the active ammunition instead falls into the target's space, remaining active. If you or one of the four selected creatures include the ammunition in the area of a spell that is 5th rank or lower; has an area of a burst, cone, or line; and does not have a duration, the materials in the ammunition immediately duplicate that spell with the same parameters. A duplicated spell can't be duplicated again by another effect. Duplicating a spell destroys the ammunition, which otherwise remains active for 1 minute.

</column>

<title

    right="Item 13"
    pfs="Standard"
>
[Spell-Bastion](/Equipment.aspx?ID=1392)
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Uncommon" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=159" />
<trait label="Abjuration" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=2" />
<trait label="Magical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=103" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Grand Bazaar](/Sources.aspx?ID=100) pg. 89

**Price** 2,700 gp

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** applied to shield

</row>

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

A _spell-bastion_ rune creates a reservoir of eldritch energy within the shield. A spellcaster can spend 1 minute to Cast a Spell of 3rd level or lower into the shield. The spell must take 2 actions or fewer to cast and must be able to target a creature other than the caster. The spell has no immediate effect—it's instead stored for later. When you invest a _spell-bastion_ shield, you immediately know the name and level of the stored spell. A _spell-bastion_ shield found as treasure has a 50% chance of having a spell of the GM's choice stored in it.

**Activate** <actions string="Single Action" /> envision;    **Requirements** Your _spell-bastion_ shield is storing a spell, and you have your shield raised; **Effect** You prepare to unleash the stored spell on any foe that hits you until your next turn.

**Activate** <actions string="Free Action" /> command;   **Trigger** You use the [Shield Block](/Feats.aspx?ID=839) reaction against a foe that the stored spell can target; **Requirements** You have a spell stored in your _spell-bastion_ shield, and you've activated the shield since your last turn in preparation for unleashing the spell; **Effect** You unleash the stored spell, which uses the target of the triggering attack as the target of the spell. This empties the spell from the shield and allows a spell to be cast into it again.

**Activate** <actions string="Single Action" /> command;     **Effect** You harmlessly expend the stored spell. This frees the shield to have a new spell cast into it.

<column gap="tiny">

</column>

A spellcaster can spend 1 minute to Cast a Spell of 3rd level or lower into the shield. The spell must take 2 actions or fewer to cast and must be able to target a creature other than the caster. Activate Single Action envision; Requirements Your spell-bastion shield is storing a spell, and you have your shield raised; Effect You prepare to unleash the stored spell on any foe that hits you until your next turn. Activate Free Action command; Trigger You use the Shield Block reaction against a foe that the stored spell can target; Requirements You have a spell stored in your spell-bastion shield, and you've activated the shield since your last turn in preparation for unleashing the spell; Effect You unleash the stored spell, which uses the target of the triggering attack as the target of the spell. This empties the spell from the shield and allows a spell to be cast into it again. Activate Single Action command; Effect You harmlessly expend the stored spell. This frees the shield to have a new spell cast into it.

---

This gummy resin contains sparkling motes of magical energy that dramatically impair your cognitive functions and dispel spells as you cast them. Spell energy manifests but then sputters out, as though drained away by the sparkling motes. While you're [stupefied](/Conditions.aspx?ID=37) by this poison, the DC of flat checks to avoid disruption from the stupefied condition when you Cast a Spell is 5 + twice the stupefied value, rather than 5 + the stupefied value.

 **Saving Throw** DC 31 Fortitude; **Maximum Duration** 6 rounds; **Stage 1** 5d6 poison damage and stupefied 1 (1 round); **Stage 2** 6d6 poison damage and stupefied 3 (1 round); **Stage 3** 7d6 poison damage and stupefied 4 (1 round)

**Craft Requirements** Supply one casting of 6th-level [_dispel magic_](/Spells.aspx?ID=78).

<traits>

<trait label="Magical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=103" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Core Rulebook](/Sources.aspx?ID=1) pg. 585

**Price** 2,700 gp

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** etched onto a melee weapon

</row>

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

A _spell-storing_ rune creates a reservoir of eldritch energy within the etched weapon. A spellcaster can spend 1 minute to cast a spell of 3rd level or lower into the weapon. The spell must have a casting of 2 actions or fewer and must be able to target a creature other than the caster. The spell has no immediate effect—it is instead stored for later. When you wield a _spell-storing_ weapon, you immediately know the name and level of the stored spell. A _spell-storing_ weapon found as treasure has a 50% chance of having a spell of the GM’s choice stored in it.

**Activate** <actions string="Single Action" /> command;    **Requirements** On your previous action this turn, you hit and damaged a creature with this weapon; **Effect** You unleash the stored spell, which uses the target of the triggering attack as the target of the spell. This empties the spell from the weapon and allows a spell to be cast into it again. If the spell requires a spell attack roll, the result of your attack roll with the weapon determines the degree of success of the spell, and if the spell requires a saving throw, the DC is 30.

**Activate** <actions string="Single Action" /> command;     **Effect** Harmlessly expend the stored spell. This frees the weapon to have a new spell cast into it.

Spellcasting services, listed on Table 6–15, are uncommon. Having a spell cast for you requires finding a spellcaster who knows and is willing to cast it. It’s hard to find someone who can cast higher-rank spells, and uncommon spells typically cost at least 100% more, if you can find someone who knows them at all. Spells that take a long time to cast (over 1 minute) usually cost 25% more. You must pay any cost listed in the spell in addition to the Price on the table.

Spellcasting services, listed on Table 6–15, are uncommon. Having a spell cast for you requires finding a spellcaster who knows and is willing to cast it. It’s hard to find someone who can cast higher-rank spells, and uncommon spells typically cost at least 100% more, if you can find someone who knows them at all. Spells that take a long time to cast (over 1 minute) usually cost 25% more. You must pay any cost listed in the spell in addition to the Price on the table.

Spellcasting services, listed on Table 6–15, are uncommon. Having a spell cast for you requires finding a spellcaster who knows and is willing to cast it. It’s hard to find someone who can cast higher-rank spells, and uncommon spells typically cost at least 100% more, if you can find someone who knows them at all. Spells that take a long time to cast (over 1 minute) usually cost 25% more. You must pay any cost listed in the spell in addition to the Price on the table.

<title
    level="1"
    right="Item 17"
    pfs=""
>
[Spellcutter](/Equipment.aspx?ID=1457)
</title>

<spoilers>May contain spoilers from Strength of Thousands</spoilers>

<traits>
<trait label="Unique" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=161" />
<trait label="Abjuration" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=2" />
<trait label="Cursed" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=274" />
<trait label="Magical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=103" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Pathfinder #173: Doorway to the Red Star](/Sources.aspx?ID=103) pg. 76

**Price** 15,000 gp

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** held in 1 hand

**Bulk** 1
</row>

<row gap="medium">
**Base Weapon** [Longsword](/Weapons.aspx?ID=31)
</row>

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

The blade of this _+2 [greater striking](/Equipment.aspx?ID=280) [adamantine](/Equipment.aspx?ID=374) [longsword](/Weapons.aspx?ID=31)_ seems to absorb light from the air around it, giving the impression the wielder is standing in the shadow of a much larger creature. While _Spellcutter_ is a potent weapon for battling [undead](/Traits.aspx?ID=160) and [constructs](/Traits.aspx?ID=35), an ancient restriction on the blade prevents it from harming living creatures; attacks against living beings deal no damage. This restriction doesn't apply to [dhampirs](/Ancestries.aspx?ID=23) or creatures with the [negative healing](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=42) ability who are otherwise living; the magic of the blade can't distinguish between such beings and undead.

**Activate** <actions string="Reaction" /> envision;   **Trigger** You're targeted by a spell while wielding _Spellcutter_;  **Effect** _Spellcutter_ attempts to absorb the magic of the triggering spell, giving you a +4 status bonus to your AC and saves against the effect.

**Activate** <actions string="Single Action" /> Interact;     **Effect** Touching _Spellcutter_ to any light source of 12th level or lower (including 6th-level spells with the [light](/Traits.aspx?ID=100) trait) instantly extinguishes the effect. If the source of the light is a large flame, such as a forest fire or bonfire, it only extinguishes the light source in a 5-foot radius burst from the point of contact.

</column>

---

This knife is a _+1 [striking](/Equipment.aspx?ID=280) [returning](/Equipment.aspx?ID=301) [dagger](/Weapons.aspx?ID=3)_ with a wide blade and thick wooden handle. A prayer for protection from evil magic is carved into the handle in tiny script, running around the handle in a spiral. The grooves of the carved prayer provide a good grip on the knife and make it easy to catch when it returns to your hand.

**Activate** <actions string="Reaction" /> envision;  **Frequency** once per day; **Trigger** You critically hit with the weapon;  **Effect** The dagger casts a 4th-level [_dispel magic_](/Spells.aspx?ID=78) targeting the most powerful spell effect affecting the creature you critically hit. The [counteract](/Rules.aspx?ID=371) check is +15.

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** held in 1 hand

**Bulk** L
</row>

<row gap="medium">
<row gap="tiny"><row>**Activate**</row><actions string="Single Action" /><row>Strike</row></row>

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

The mixture of reagents, liquid [djezet](/Equipment.aspx?ID=1410), and solid metal shrapnel inside this grenade explodes on contact with air. A spellsap grenade deals the listed slashing damage and [splash](/Traits.aspx?ID=150) damage. On a hit against a prepared or spontaneous spellcaster, the target must succeed at a Will saving throw with the listed DC or lose one prepared spell or one spontaneous spell slot. The spell is randomly selected from among the caster's highest three spell ranks (and then from among the spells prepared in that rank, for a prepared spellcaster). The grenade grant an item bonus to attack rolls.

>
[Spellslasher](/Equipment.aspx?ID=3895)
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Consumable" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=36" />
<trait label="Magical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=103" />
<trait label="Whetstone" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=861" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Battlecry!](/Sources.aspx?ID=268) pg. 137

**Price** 1,200 gp

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** held in 1 hand

**Bulk** L
</row>

<row gap="medium">
<row gap="tiny"><row>**Activate**</row><actions string="Single Action" /><row>([manipulate](/Traits.aspx?ID=645))</row></row>

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

A _spellslasher_ is made of faceted crystal, its edges sharp and oddly misaligned. When it’s applied to a weapon, it attunes the weapon to magical energies, allowing it to slice through spells as though they were physical threads. While your weapon is under the effect of a _spellslasher_, you gain the Spellslash reaction; you can use this reaction only with the affected weapon, and the _spellslasher’s_ effects end as soon as you use Spellslash.

**Spellslash**  <actions string="Reaction" /> ([magical](/Traits.aspx?ID=644), [manipulate](/Traits.aspx?ID=645)) **Trigger** You are the only target of a spell; **Effect** You swing or shoot your weapon to intercept the magic, attempting to [counteract](/Rules.aspx?ID=2250) the spell. Your counteract rank is equal to half your level (rounded up), and your counteract check modifier is equal to your attack modifier with the affected weapon.

</column>

    right="Item 0"
    pfs="Standard"
>
[Spellstrike Ammunition](/Equipment.aspx?ID=167)
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Consumable" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=36" />
<trait label="Magical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=103" />
<trait label="Transmutation" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=157" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Core Rulebook](/Sources.aspx?ID=1) pg. 560

<row gap="medium">
**Ammunition** any

</row>

<row gap="medium">
<row gap="tiny"><row>**Activate**</row><actions string="Two Actions" /><row>Cast a Spell</row></row>

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

Mystic patterns create a magic reservoir within this ammunition. You activate _spellstrike ammunition_ by Casting a Spell into the ammunition. The spell must be of a spell level the ammunition can hold, and the spell must be able to target a creature other than the caster. A creature hit by activated _spellstrike ammunition_ is targeted by the spell. If the creature isn’t a valid target for the spell, the spell is lost.

 The ammunition affects only the target hit, even if the spell would normally affect more than one target. If the spell requires a spell attack roll, use the result of your ranged attack roll with the ammunition to determine the degree of success of the spell. If the spell requires a saving throw, the target attempts the save against your spell DC.

 The maximum level of spell the ammunition can hold determines its item level and Price.

</column>

**Source** [Treasure Vault (Remastered)](/Sources.aspx?ID=191) pg. 134 **Usage** held in 1 hand **Bulk** 1 --- A _spellstriker staff_ is wrought iron with gleaming arcane sigils etched into its surface and a sharp point at the bottom. Used as a weapon, the staff is a _+1 [striking](/Equipment.aspx?ID=280) [shifting](/Equipment.aspx?ID=302) [staff](/Weapons.aspx?ID=12)_. **Activate** ([concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=561)) **Frequency** once per hour; **Trigger** You use [Spellstrike](/Actions.aspx?ID=755) with a non-cantrip spell and miss with the Strike; **Effect** An explosion of magical energy—stored up for the Spellstrike—explodes out. All creatures in a 5-foot emanation take 1d6 damage per level of the spell, with a [basic](/Rules.aspx?ID=329) Reflex save against your spell DC. This damage is the same type the spell would have dealt, and the activation gains that trait; if the spell would have dealt multiple types of damage, choose one of them. If the damage of the explosion is mental, the save is Will instead of Reflex. **Activate** Cast a Spell; **Effect** You expend a number of charges from the staff to cast a spell from its list. **Craft Requirements** You have the [magus's](/Classes.aspx?ID=17) Spellstrike activity. Supply one casting of all listed levels of all listed spells. Spellstriker Staff **Source** [Treasure Vault (Remastered)](/Sources.aspx?ID=191) pg. 134 **Price** 360 gp **Bulk** 1 ---
  • **Cantrip** [_ignition_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1565)
  • **1st** [_echoing weapon_](/Spells.aspx?ID=899), [_sure strike_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1709)
  • **2nd** [_acid grip_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1436), [_telekinetic maneuver_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1717)
Spellstriker Staff (Greater) **Source** [Treasure Vault (Remastered)](/Sources.aspx?ID=191) pg. 134 **Price** 1,400 gp **Bulk** 1 --- Used as a weapon, the staff is a _+2 striking shifting staff_.
  • **3rd** _echoing weapon_, [_haste_](/Spells.aspx?ID=147)
  • **4th** _acid grip_, [_weapon storm_](/Spells.aspx?ID=373)
Spellstriker Staff (Major) **Source** [Treasure Vault (Remastered)](/Sources.aspx?ID=191) pg. 134 **Price** 8,500 gp **Bulk** 1 --- Used as a weapon, the staff is a _+2 greater striking shifting staff_.
  • **5th** [_blink charge_](/Spells.aspx?ID=872), _echoing weapon_, [_vampiric feast_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1736)
  • **6th** _acid grip_, _weapon storm_
  • **7th** _blink charge_, [_true target_](/Spells.aspx?ID=346)

<title
    level="1"
    right="Item 27"
    pfs=""
>
[Sphere of Annihilation](/Equipment.aspx?ID=620)
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Rare" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=137" />
<trait label="Artifact" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=253" />
<trait label="Magical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=103" />
<trait label="Transmutation" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=157" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Gamemastery Guide](/Sources.aspx?ID=22) pg. 113

<row gap="medium">

</row>

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

A _sphere of annihilation_ is a floating black sphere that pulls any matter that comes into contact with it into a void, destroying it utterly. Anything or anyone destroyed by the sphere can be brought back only by a deity’s direct intervention. The sphere can’t be counteracted by [_dispel magic_](/Spells.aspx?ID=78) or similar effects.

 The sphere stays entirely still until caused to move by a creature controlling it. Taking control of the sphere requires succeeding at an attempt to activate it. A [_talisman of the sphere_](/Equipment.aspx?ID=621) makes it easier to control the sphere.

**Activate** <actions string="Single Action" /> command;    **Requirements** You are within 40 feet of the sphere; **Effect** You attempt a DC 30 [Arcana](/Skills.aspx?ID=2) or [Occultism](/Skills.aspx?ID=11) check to take control of the sphere. If someone else already controls the sphere, this check uses their Will DC if higher. If you succeed, you take control of the sphere. If you fail, the sphere moves 10 feet closer to you (or 20 feet on a critical failure). You keep control as long as you remain within 80 feet of the sphere and Sustain the Activation each round. When you Sustain the Activation, you must attempt a DC 30 Arcana or Occultism check. If you succeed, you direct the sphere to move up to 10 feet in a straight line (or up to 20 feet on a critical success). On a failure, you lose control of the sphere, and it moves 10 feet closer to you in a straight line (or 20 feet on a critical failure).

**Destruction** When a [_gate_](/Spells.aspx?ID=130) spell is cast such that its rift overlaps a _sphere of annihilation_, roll d%. On a result of 1–50, the sphere is destroyed; on a 51–85, the spell is disrupted; and on a 86–100, everything within an 180-foot emanation of the sphere is pulled to another plane through a tear in the spatial fabric. If a _rod of cancellation_ (_Pathfinder Advanced Player’s Guide_) touches the sphere, both items explode, dealing 14d6 bludgeoning damage (DC 35 basic Reflex save) to everything in a 60-foot burst from the point of their destruction.

</column>

[Spider Gun](/Equipment.aspx?ID=1170)
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Uncommon" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=159" />
<trait label="Magical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=103" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Guns & Gears (Remastered)](/Sources.aspx?ID=98) pg. 155

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** held in 2 hands

**Bulk** 2
</row>

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

A _spider gun_ is a _+1 striking weapon_. It's a distinct type of martial firearm made from the fangs and spinneret of a Large spider. It deals 1d10 poison damage with a [range increment](/Traits.aspx?ID=248) of 30 feet and [reload 1](/Traits.aspx?ID=254). On a critical hit, the venom clings to the target and they take [persistent poison damage](/Conditions.aspx?ID=29) equal to 1d4 + the number of weapon damage dice. A spider gun does not add critical specialization effects. The gun can be activated to fire webbing that hampers other creatures.

**Activate** <actions string="Single Action" /> ([manipulate](/Traits.aspx?ID=645)) **Frequency** once per round;   **Effect** You fire a mass of webbing at a square within 30 feet. That square becomes covered in webbing for 1 minute. A square covered with the webbing from a _spider gun_ can be cleared by a single attack or effect that deals at least 5 slashing damage or 1 fire damage. A square has AC 5, and it automatically fails its saving throws. The first time each turn a creature in the webbing begins to use a move action or enters the webbing during a move action, it must attempt an [Athletics](/Skills.aspx?ID=3) check or Reflex save against DC 20. On a success, it moves normally through the webbing and clears away the webbing from any squares it enters this turn. On a failure, it treats squares of webbing as difficult terrain this turn, and on a critical failure, it's [immobilized](/Conditions.aspx?ID=24) for 1 round or until it [Escapes](/Actions.aspx?ID=79) (DC 20) or destroys the webbing.

**Craft Requirements** The initial raw materials for the _spider gun_ must include the fangs and spinneret of a giant spider or other Large spider.

</row>

---

A _spider gun_ is a _+1 striking weapon_. It's a distinct type of martial firearm made from the fangs and spinneret of a Large spider. It deals 1d10 poison damage with a [range increment](/Traits.aspx?ID=248) of 30 feet and [reload 1](/Traits.aspx?ID=254). On a critical hit, the venom clings to the target and they take [persistent poison damage](/Conditions.aspx?ID=29) equal to 1d4 + the number of weapon damage dice. A spider gun does not add critical specialization effects. The gun can be activated to fire webbing that hampers other creatures.

**Activate** <actions string="Single Action" /> ([manipulate](/Traits.aspx?ID=645)) **Frequency** once per round;   **Effect** You fire a mass of webbing at a square within 30 feet. That square becomes covered in webbing for 1 minute. A square covered with the webbing from a _spider gun_ can be cleared by a single attack or effect that deals at least 5 slashing damage or 1 fire damage. A square has AC 5, and it automatically fails its saving throws. The first time each turn a creature in the webbing begins to use a move action or enters the webbing during a move action, it must attempt an [Athletics](/Skills.aspx?ID=3) check or Reflex save against DC 20. On a success, it moves normally through the webbing and clears away the webbing from any squares it enters this turn. On a failure, it treats squares of webbing as difficult terrain this turn, and on a critical failure, it's [immobilized](/Conditions.aspx?ID=24) for 1 round or until it [Escapes](/Actions.aspx?ID=79) (DC 20) or destroys the webbing.

**Craft Requirements** The initial raw materials for the _spider gun_ must include the fangs and spinneret of a giant spider or other Large spider.

>
[Spider Lily Tattoo](/Equipment.aspx?ID=2687)
</title>

<spoilers>May contain spoilers from Season of Ghosts</spoilers>

<traits>
<trait label="Rare" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=137" />
<trait label="Invested" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=98" />
<trait label="Magical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=103" />
<trait label="Necromancy" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=117" />
<trait label="Tattoo" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=262" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Pathfinder #196: The Summer That Never Was](/Sources.aspx?ID=214) pg. 82

**Price** 60 gp

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** tattooed on the body

</row>

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

The _spider lily tattoo_ marks you as a trusted member of Granny Hu's network. This crimson tattoo fades and becomes invisible within a day of being applied, reappearing only when you Activate it, when you gain the [doomed](/Conditions.aspx?ID=9) condition, or when you die. The higher the doomed value, the more vivid the color. If your tattoo is plainly visible, you gain a +1 item bonus to [Intimidation](/Skills.aspx?ID=7) checks against all creatures that can see the tattoo, but you take a –1 item penalty to [Diplomacy](/Skills.aspx?ID=6) checks to [Make an Impression](/Actions.aspx?ID=50) on those who understand the actual meaning of the _spider lily tattoo_ (including all of Willowshore's citizens).

**Activate** <actions string="Single Action" /> envision ([concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=32))   **Requirements** Your tattoo isn't currently visible; **Effect** You make the tattoo visible. You can use this activation again to make the tattoo not visible, unless you have the doomed condition.

**Activate** <actions string="Reaction" /> envision ([concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=32)) **Frequency** once per day; **Trigger** An [undead](/Traits.aspx?ID=160) creature detects you for the first time;  **Effect** The _spider lily tattoo_ manipulates your life force to make you appear to be undead for a short time. Attempt a [Deception](/Skills.aspx?ID=5) check against the triggering undead creature's Perception DC. On a success, the triggering undead believes you're undead as well—a [mindless](/Traits.aspx?ID=108) undead is likely to ignore you, while a sapient undead might react with curiosity or confusion. You can continue attempting Deception checks each round as a single action to Sustain the effect for up to 1 minute.

<column gap="tiny">

</column>

fields.text: Item 3 Spider Lily Tattoo May contain spoilers from Season of Ghosts Rare Invested Magical Tattoo Source Season of Ghosts (Hardcover) pg. 305 Price 60 gp Usage tattooed on the body The spider lily tattoo marks you as a trusted member of Granny Hu’s network. This crimson tattoo fades and becomes invisible within a day of being applied, reappearing only when you Activate it, when you gain the doomed condition, or when you die. The higher the doomed value, the more vivid the color. Additional rules for magical tattoos appear here. If your tattoo is plainly visible, you gain a +1 item bonus to Intimidation checks against all creatures that can see the tattoo, but you take a –1 item penalty to Diplomacy checks to Make an Impression on those who understand the actual meaning of the spider lily tattoo (including all of Willowshore’s citizens). Activate—Reveal Tattoo Single Action (concentrate) Requirements Your tattoo isn't currently visible; Effect You make the tattoo visible. You can use this activation again to make the tattoo not visible, unless you have the doomed condition. Activate—Dead Like You Reaction (concentrate) Frequency once per day; Trigger An undead creature detects you for the first time, and you’re aware of the undead creature; Effect The spider lily tattoo manipulates your life force to make you appear to be undead for a short time. Attempt a Deception check against the triggering undead creature’s Perception DC. On a success, the triggering undead believes you’re undead as well—a mindless undead is likely to ignore you, while a sapient undead might react with curiosity or confusion. You can continue attempting Deception checks each round as a single action to Sustain the effect for up to 1 minute.

---

The Verduran Forest’s tiny tent-trap spider lays her eggs in a pyramidal web, and her young hatch only in response to intense vibration, such as the struggles of an ensnared insect or even songbird. Sadistic alchemists gather and augment these eggs, packing them in silken satchels that disgorge thousands of biting spider babies on impact. Many types of spider satchel grant a bonus to attack rolls. 

Until shaken off—or for the desperate target, incinerated—these spiders make it difficult to concentrate on anything other than escaping the swarm. The [fascination](/Conditions.aspx?ID=72) effect ends automatically if a creature uses further [hostile action](/Rules.aspx?ID=2251)s against the target, but hostile actions against the target’s allies don’t automatically end the effect.

<title
    level="1"
    right="Item 6"
    pfs="Standard"
>
[Spike Launcher](/Equipment.aspx?ID=1171)
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Uncommon" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=159" />
<trait label="Magical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=103" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Guns & Gears (Remastered)](/Sources.aspx?ID=98) pg. 156

**Price** 250 gp

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** held in 1 or 2 hands

**Bulk** 2
</row>

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

Built from the spiked tail of a [manticore](/Monsters.aspx?ID=294), a _spike launcher_ is designed to launch large, spear-like projectiles. A spike launcher is a _+1 striking weapon_. It's a distinct type of martial firearm that deals 1d8 piercing damage. It has the [backstabber](/Traits.aspx?ID=172), [fatal aim d12](/Traits.aspx?ID=404), and [kickback](/Traits.aspx?ID=409) traits with a [range increment](/Traits.aspx?ID=248) of 120 feet and [reload 2](/Traits.aspx?ID=254). It uses the critical specialization of the [bow](/WeaponGroups.aspx?ID=3) weapon group, rather than the firearm critical specialization.

**Activate** <actions string="Three Actions" /> ([manipulate](/Traits.aspx?ID=645)) **Frequency** once per day;  **Requirements** The _spike launcher_ is loaded; **Effect** The _spike launcher_ fires a volley of smaller spikes in a 10-foot burst centered anywhere within its range. Make a Strike with the _spike launcher_ against each creature in the area. These attacks count toward the your multiple attack penalty, but the multiple attack penalty doesn't increase until after you make all of your attacks. On a success, the spike causes the creature to take a –5-foot status penalty to their Speed. On a critical success, the creature becomes [immobilized](/Conditions.aspx?ID=24) instead. In either case, the creature, or an adjacent creature, can use an Interact action to remove the spike and end the penalty or immobilized condition.

**Craft Requirements** The initial raw materials must include the tail of a manticore.

<column gap="tiny">

</column>

<title
    level="1"
    right="Item 17"
    pfs=""
>
[Spindle Key](/Equipment.aspx?ID=5209)
</title>

<spoilers>May contain spoilers from Revenge of the Runelords</spoilers>

<traits>
<trait label="Rare" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=683" />
<trait label="Mythic" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=835" />
<trait label="Occult" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=662" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Pathfinder #220: Crypt of Runes](/Sources.aspx?ID=284) pg. 83

**Price** 14,000 gp

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** held in 2 hands

**Bulk** 1
</row>

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

This foot-long, spindle-shaped puzzle box is made of otherworldly metal inlaid with a finely traced labyrinth pattern. By manipulating the key’s length, the wider spindle can be caused to open, unfold, and move up and down along the shaft, often in ways that defy geometry. Every _spindle key_ is attuned to one of the prison-spires that float above the Oubliette Plains in the Dreamlands. As a 10-minute activity, a creature can solve a _spindle key_ by attempting a DC 37 [Occultism](/Skills.aspx?ID=44) check. On a success, that PC can thereafter use both of the _spindle key’s_ activations. On a critical failure, the key’s magic plays havoc with the creature’s spatial awareness. The creature becomes [clumsy](/Conditions.aspx?ID=61) 1 for 24 hours (which can’t be reduced by any means) and can’t attempt to solve the _spindle key_ again until the effect ends. 

**Activate—Align Spindle** <actions string="Two Actions" /> ([concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=561), [manipulate](/Traits.aspx?ID=645), [occult](/Traits.aspx?ID=662))    **Effect** You rotate the sections of the _spindle key_ into an arrangement of your liking. As you do, the corresponding steel separators between floors of Liralarue’s Oubliette spin to match that arrangement. If a creature is within the ten-foot-space between floors at this time, they take 10d6 bludgeoning damage (DC 37 [basic](/Rules.aspx?ID=2297) Reflex save) from being crushed and are then pushed into one of the adjoining rooms at random as the rotation seals it up. 

**Activate—Breach** <actions string="Two Actions" /> ([concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=561), [manipulate](/Traits.aspx?ID=645), [occult](/Traits.aspx?ID=662)) **Frequency** once per hour;   **Effect** You harness the key’s occult geometry to bypass a lock within 30 feet. You attempt to [Pick the Lock](/Actions.aspx?ID=2412), using [Occultism](/Skills.aspx?ID=44) instead of [Thievery](/Skills.aspx?ID=50) for the check. You can spend a Mythic Point to attempt the check at mythic proficiency.

</column>

**Source** [GM Core](/Sources.aspx?ID=218) pg. 234 **Price** 360 gp **Usage** held in 1 hand **Bulk** 1 **Base Shield** [Steel Shield](/Shields.aspx?ID=19) --- Five jagged spines project from the surface of this steel shield (Hardness 6, HP 24, BT 12). The spines are _+1 striking_ [shield spikes](/Weapons.aspx?ID=42). When you use the [Shield Block](/Feats.aspx?ID=839) reaction with this shield, the spines take the damage before the shield itself does. When the shield would take damage (after applying Hardness), one spine snaps off per 6 damage, reducing the damage by 6. The shield takes any remaining damage. When there are no spines left, the shield takes damage as normal.
When all the spines are gone, you lose the ability to attack with them until the spines regenerate the next day. **Activate—Fire Spine** ([manipulate](/Traits.aspx?ID=104)) **Effect** You shoot one of the shield's spines at a target. A fired spine uses the spikes' statistics, but it's a martial ranged weapon with a range increment of 120 feet.

Five jagged spines project from the surface of this [steel shield](/Shields.aspx?ID=3) (Hardness 6, HP 24, BT 12). The spines are _+1 striking [shield spikes](/Weapons.aspx?ID=42)_. When you use the [Shield Block](/Feats.aspx?ID=839) reaction with this shield, the spines take the damage before the shield itself does. When the shield would take damage (after applying Hardness), one spine snaps off per 6 damage, reducing the damage by 6. The shield takes any remaining damage. When there are no spines left, the shield takes damage as normal.

When all the spines are gone, you lose the ability to attack with them until the spines regenerate the next day.

**Activate** <actions string="Single Action" /> Interact;     **Effect** You shoot one of the shield’s spines at a target. A fired spine uses the spikes’ statistics, but it is a martial ranged weapon with a [range increment of 120 feet](/Traits.aspx?ID=248).

  • **Armor** You gain a +1 item bonus to [Athletics](/Skills.aspx?ID=3) checks and resistance 2 to [nonlethal](/Traits.aspx?ID=188) damage.
